rules: This reservation and the exact V42 relabel coordinate must be committed before dev-v38 membership creation or model work.
Membership construction and disjointness verification are primary-agent-only and must not render seed values into agent output.
Dev-v38 must be generated solely within [6000000000,7000000000), disjoint by namespace from every prior governed set without reading their membership.
The committed one-way consumer must atomically create the dev-v38 umbrella attempt before its first manifest read or baseline episode.
A started, aborted, failed, exposed, or completed dev-v38 attempt consumes that set permanently.
No dev-v38 access is authorized until exact replicas and reusable permanent-greedy and matched-greedy scorecards pass.
Held-out-v6 remains governed by ADR-0053 and cannot be read until dev-v38 passes every frozen gate.
